summary: Build skills mobility, internal matching, and governance tools in 5 days. Train with practical templates and dashboards.
lede: Internal talent marketplace and skills mobility training helps HR, talent, and workforce-planning professionals connect employee skills with internal roles and projects. Participants practice building skills inventories and role-to-skill matrices, then designing opportunity-matching rules and mobility governance workflows. They also learn to track measures such as internal mobility and skills coverage and plan a phased pilot.
audienceIntro: This internal talent marketplaces and skills mobility training is built for professionals who manage internal movement, skills data, and workforce planning decisions across HR and business functions.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of talent management, workforce planning, or HR operations, plus familiarity with basic HR metrics such as turnover, vacancy rates, and internal fill rate. Prior exposure to HRIS, ATS, LMS, or people analytics dashboards is helpful but not mandatory. No coding is required. The course assumes you can work with spreadsheet-based skills data, review role profiles, and contribute to cross-functional planning discussions about internal mobility, skills taxonomy design, and talent marketplace governance.
